messages:
Kevin: Quick sync. We're seeing a ton of churn where pins expire and clients immediately re-create them, which floods placement and makes capacity unstable. Thinking we need a clearer pin surface contract + a light server-side eviction probe to reduce thrash.

Jess: Example fields? want to see exactly what you'd add to the pin schema.

Kevin: My sketch: server-authoritative `lease_until`, a `grace_window_s` for short soft-retention after expiry, and an `evict_hint` enum (low|normal|high) so schedulers can prefer evicting low-hint pins. Clients can send `requested_lease_s` but server returns the final `lease_until`.

Maria: telemetry backs this—~40% of re-pins happen within 60s. a small grace window would absorb most of it.

Sanjay: agree on authority boundaries. Clients should only ask; server decides. propose API change: register/renew returns `{ pin_id, lease_until, pin_origin }` so callers always trust server time.

Anna: mobile/edge clients sometimes persist local pin tokens and blindly re-register. we need idempotent register semantics and a `last_seen` we can use to distinguish a re-registration vs new demand.

Oliver: alternative/complement: add an eviction probe step. before evicting a pin marked low, do N cheap probes against the prefix/KV or last-route to confirm zero real traffic. If probes show hits, postpone. probes should be cheap and async.

Kevin: eviction probe flow: for `evict_hint=low` run up to N probes with backoff. If all probes return zero hits, proceed to evict. Record probe result on pin row for debugging.

Jess: please add probe telemetry fields (probe_time_ms, probe_hits) we can show in the console and use in alerts.

Sanjay: probes add async complexity and slow eviction decisions. we should bound them (max_probes=2, max_wait_s=30) and make the probes opt-in per policy (enterprise vs self-serve).

Maria: Suggest also a `stability_score` float [0..1] derived from recent activity (re-reg rate, hit frequency). Use it to bias eviction order: low stability evicted first.

Kevin: Proposed server pin metadata (authoritative fields) example:

```
pin_metadata:
  pin_origin: system
  lease_until: 2025-04-12T23:59:00Z
  grace_window_s: 120
  evict_hint: low
  stability_score: 0.27
  last_probe: 2025-04-12T23:54:10Z
  last_probe_result: 0
```

Anna: Ops/UX note: teams want guaranteed non-eviction for canaries. we should support `pin_protection: protected` which bypasses eviction/probes but counts against capacity and requires an explicit owner.

Oliver: storage note: keep pin rows small. compute stability_score in the metrics pipeline/streaming aggregator and write only the score + last_probe summary to the pin row. don't store raw probe logs inline.

Maria: telemetry additions: re-registration-rate per pin, probe_success_rate, time_between_expiry_and_repin. Those will help tune defaults.

infra-bot: pin-service: eviction-run started for shard-7 (candidate_count=312). performing probes with max_probes=2 and max_wait_s=30.

deploy-bot: rolling out pin-meta-schema v2 -> staging. feature flag: `pin_eviction_probes=true`. No downtime expected.

Kevin: consensus plan for RFC: 1) schema fields (`requested_lease_s`, `lease_until`, `grace_window_s`, `evict_hint`, `pin_origin`, `pin_protection`, `stability_score`, `last_probe_result`, `client_schema_version`), 2) telemetry hooks and dashboard, 3) probe worker implementation with bounded timeouts, 4) rollout via flagging (opt-in) then enable for default tiers.

Sanjay: I'll draft the API/authority section and update register/renew semantics (server returns `lease_until` + `pin_id`).

Jess: I'll mock dashboard panels and add probe metrics to the RFC PR.

Maria: owners? Kevin (probe worker design), Oliver (storage/compaction), Sanjay (API), Jess (telemetry).

Anna: add `client_schema_version` so older clients don't break if semantics change.

Kevin: action items recorded. RFC cut tomorrow. @Sanjay ping ops once staging is live so we can watch the eviction-run logs.

infra-bot: eviction-run logs: https://internal.redwood/pin-evict/shard-7/1742005123

Oliver: follow-up defaults suggestion: `grace_window_s=120`, `max_probes=2`, `probe_backoff_s=5`. keeps tests stable.

Kevin: cool. wrap-up: Sanjay -> RFC draft, Jess -> dashboards, Kevin -> probe design, Oliver -> store changes, Maria -> telemetry queries. target EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

Anna: :thumbsup:
